description: Shows the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 coins balance and history, the reward points earned on print orders; use it when someone asks about their coins. For ways to earn coins use loyalty_tasks; for redeeming rules use search_knowledge. Takes no input. Returns the balance and the earned and redeemed entries. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "how many coins do I have", "my coin history", "what did I redeem last month", "my 4OVER4 rewards balance".
name: get_my_coins
